name: @tuucho/plugin-tuucho-commerce-vouchers
description: Promo codes at checkout and the Vouchers admin page. Disable to hide both.

codeMax.label: Voucher code max length
codeMax.description: Maximum characters a voucher code may have. Raise only if you issue longer codes.
codeMax.sectionDescription: Code length and how often a customer may try a code at checkout.

rateVoucher.label: Voucher rate limit
rateVoucher.description: Window:max for voucher attempts (for example 60s:10). Protects checkout from guessing.

disableRateVoucher.label: Disable voucher rate limit
disableRateVoucher.description: Turn on only on a local shop while testing. Leave off in production.
